strategy.description: How versions and changelogs are determined: conventional-commits (git-cliff) or changesets (.changeset directory).

branch.description: Branch to release from. Defaults to the CI default branch, then "main".

cliff-config.description: Path to the git-cliff config. Defaults to git-cliff's own discovery.

rewrite-changelog.description: Regenerate the whole changelog of every released package when the git-cliff config changed since its last release.

pre-commit-script.description: Script in the working tree (path relative to the repository root) that runs after the release files are written and before they are committed. Everything it changes ends up in the release commit.

pre-commit-script-tokens.description: Pass RELWOLF_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN and GITLAB_TOKEN to the pre-commit-script; they are removed from its environment by default.

pull-request-title.description: Title of the release request (single line). Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}.

pull-request-body.description: Body template of the release request; must contain ${notes} exactly once. Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}, ${releases}, ${hint}, ${release}, ${notes}.

release-commit-message.description: Message of the release commit (may span several lines). Defaults to the request title. Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}.

release-name.description: Title template of the created releases. Placeholders: ${tag}, ${version}, ${component}.

tag-template.description: Tag format. Must contain ${version} exactly once and may contain ${component} once.

labels.description: Labels used to track release requests.

pending.description: Label of open release requests ("relwolf: pending").

tagged.description: Label of merged and tagged release requests ("relwolf: tagged").

draft.description: Open the release request as draft.

release-emoji.description: Prefix the default release title with a random emoji.

changelog-links.description: Link the changelogs of all other packages in the header of the changelog of the root package.

changelog-links-text.default: For changes to individual components, see their changelogs:

no-changes-text.default: No changes, version bumped to stay in sync.
no-changes-text.description: Text for packages that were only released to follow linked packages; empty to add nothing.

assignees.description: Usernames assigned when the release request is created.

reviewers.description: Usernames requested as reviewers when the request is created.

ai-release-notes.description: AI generated release notes. Enabled by changelog, release and/or at least one entry of additional-files; the other options are only defaults for them.

provider.description: copilot-cli (default) runs the GitHub Copilot CLI; openai calls an OpenAI-compatible API (base-url and model required); anthropic calls the Claude API directly (model required).

base-url.description: Base URL of the API (`/chat/completions` is appended for openai, `/messages` for anthropic); required with provider openai, defaults to https://api.anthropic.com/v1 with anthropic.

model.description: Model name; the default of the Copilot CLI if omitted, required with provider openai and anthropic.

context.description: Release context sent to the model: generated changelog content, all commits (default), or the full code diff since the previous release.

audience.description: Audience of the release notes as free text, e.g. users (default) for feature-focused notes, developers for technical notes, or your own like "product managers".

include-paths.description: Globs from the repository root; only matching files are part of the full-diff context (default: all files).

exclude-paths.description: Globs from the repository root excluded from the full-diff context, applied after include-paths.

language.description: Language of the release notes (default English).

input-price.description: Price in USD per million input tokens; with it and/or output-price, the usage comment in the release request shows the estimated cost.

output-price.description: Price in USD per million output tokens.

max-input-chars.description: Upper bound for the context sent to the model, in characters (default 30000); false removes the limit.

prompt.description: Instructions for the model instead of the built-in ones. Placeholders: ${language}, ${tag}, ${version}, ${component}, ${audience}.

generate.description: always (default) generates the release notes on every run where the commits changed; manual only generates them in a run with RELWOLF_GENERATE_AI_RELEASE_NOTES=true, e.g. just before the release request is merged.

usage-comment.description: Adds a comment to the release request with the tokens and estimated cost (see input-price / output-price) of the last run and of all runs (default false).

changelog.description: Adds release notes to the changelog: true, or an object with its own options (and packages / exclude-packages).

file.description: Markdown file (repository-relative) that gets a new entry per release. ${path} and ${component} are replaced per package, which writes one file per package.

file-title.description: First-level heading of the release notes file.

http-timeout.description: Seconds an API request attempt may take before it is aborted (1 to 3600). Timed out requests are retried, except POST requests.

patch-types.description: Commit types that trigger a patch release.

minor-types.description: Commit types that trigger a minor release. Breaking changes always trigger a major release.

exclude-paths.description: Globs from the repository root whose changes never count.

bootstrap-sha.description: History up to and including this commit is ignored for packages without a release tag.

separate-pull-requests.description: Create one release request per package or linked group.

linked-versions.description: true: all packages share one version; or a list of groups of package paths that share one.

linked-tags.description: per-package: every package gets its own tag; single: one tag and release per linked group.

prerelease.description: Pre-release identifier for all packages, e.g. "beta".

bump-minor-pre-major.description: Breaking changes only bump the minor version before 1.0.0 (default for all packages).

updaters.description: Files with component markers (x-relwolf-version:<component>) that get the versions of several packages.

type.description: Kind of file to update; only "generic" is supported.

path.description: File to update, relative to the repository root. May be a glob.

packages.description: Packages by path relative to the repository root ("." for the root).

component.description: Tag prefix of the package. Optional for a single package, required for every other package.

changelog-path.description: Changelog file, relative to the package path.

changelog-title.description: Title (first-level heading) of the changelog, replacing the one of the git-cliff header. Placeholder: ${component}.

updaters.description: Files in which the version is updated.

path.description: File to update, relative to the package path. Defaults to the usual file of the type; required for json, yaml, toml and generic.

key.description: Dotted key path of the version (json, yaml and toml updaters).

lockfiles.description: Also update the lockfiles next to the manifest.

prerelease.description: Pre-release identifier of this package, e.g. "beta".

bump-minor-pre-major.description: Breaking changes only bump the minor version before 1.0.0 (overrides the global value).

initial-version.description: First stable version if the package has no release tag yet.
